title: Chicken Shahi Korma
description: Chicken Shahi Korma is a luxurious Mughlai-style curry featuring tender chicken simmered in a rich, creamy gravy of caramelized onions, cashews, melon seeds, yogurt, and aromatic whole spices. Saffron and rose water add an elegant royal touch to this indulgent dish.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: Yogurt – ½ cup, thick and whisked

ingredients.title: For the Korma Gravy
items: Cashew nuts – ¼ cup, soaked in warm water for 15 minutes

ingredients.title: For Finishing
items: Saffron strands – a few, soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinating the Chicken
steps: In a large bowl, combine the chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Mix well to coat the chicken evenly.
Cover and marinate for at least 1 hour. For deeper flavor, marinate overnight in the refrigerator.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Nut Paste
steps: Drain the soaked cashews and melon seeds.
Grind them into a smooth paste using a little milk or water.
Set the nut paste aside.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Caramelizing the Onions
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan or kadhai over medium heat.
Add the green cardamoms, cloves, black cardamoms, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Sauté until fragrant.
Add the sliced onions and cook slowly until deeply golden brown and caramelized, about 15–20 minutes.
Take care not to burn the onions, as they provide essential depth and sweetness to the korma.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Adding Ginger-Garlic and Chicken
steps: Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw aroma disappears.
Add the marinated chicken pieces and sear until they change color and begin to brown slightly.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Adding Spices and Nut Paste
steps: Add coriander powder, garam masala, fennel powder, nutmeg powder, and salt.
Cook the spices with the chicken for about 2 minutes.
Add the cashew-melon seed paste and mix well.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Slow Cooking the Korma
steps: Pour in the fresh cream and milk, stirring gently to combine.
Cover and cook over low heat for about 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
Stir occasionally to prevent the gravy from sticking to the bottom of the pan.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Finishing with Saffron and Rose Water
steps: Add the saffron milk and rose water, if using.
Mix gently and simmer for another 5 minutes to allow the flavors to blend.

instruction.title: Step 8 – Garnishing and Serving
steps: Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
Serve hot with naan, roomali roti, or fragrant basmati rice.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with naan, roomali roti, or fragrant basmati rice.
Pair with cucumber-onion salad or cooling raita to balance the richness.
Mango lassi or sweet lime soda makes a refreshing accompaniment.

chefTips: Use fresh whole spices for a more aromatic and authentic korma.
Soak and grind raw cashews and melon seeds into a smooth paste for a rich, creamy gravy.
Use thick, full-fat yogurt and fresh cream for the best texture.
Caramelize the onions slowly without burning them; this is essential for the korma's depth of flavor.
Use pure rose water and real saffron for the most authentic royal aroma and flavor.
Bone-in chicken adds extra depth and richness to the gravy.
